The desert planet '''Malsuum''' was the site of a [[Battle of Malsuum|battle]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="DVatCoS1" /> [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[Hock Malsuum]] was marooned on the planet and was taken in by [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]]. More than two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, he left to seek out [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="DVatCoS2" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The planet appears in the [[2013]] [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] comic [[Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows 1|''Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows'' 1]].<ref name="DVatCoS1" />
